title: Museum of Industry

services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: Bring your class to the Museum of Industry and explore how work and industry have shaped life in Nova Scotia-from early settlement to the computer age. Our exhibits and artifacts help students see how technology and innovation have changed how people live and work. Each program blends hands-on activities, crafts, and real artifacts to make learning active and engaging. Students can explore, ask questions, and discover answers as they connect the past with the world around them today. Programs are led by friendly, knowledgeable museum staff and volunteers.
